REGULARIZATION
Prefer a concise rule or program that explains all examples. Avoid unnecessary special cases.

Infer the natural-language instruction that maps each input to its output. Return one concise instruction in <ans> tags.

"jacket, tortoise, chicken, taxi, pineapple, spider" => "chicken, spider, tortoise"
"dolphin, dress, whale, hippo, panda, dentist" => "dolphin, hippo, whale, panda"
"sweater, octopus, hippo, giraffe, orange" => "giraffe, octopus, hippo"
"chicken, yellow, hippo, snail, purple" => "hippo, snail, chicken"
"tiger, octopus, chocolate, shark, plane, horse" => "horse, shark, octopus, tiger"
"frog, ship, fly, motorway, dentist, horse, spider" => "fly, frog, horse, spider"
"nurse, yellow, zebra, cook, snail, bat" => "bat, zebra, snail"
"designer, monkey, lemon, penguin, camel, green" => "monkey, camel, penguin"
